# MakeHuman data (CC0 1.0)

Files in this folder are a subset of the MakeHuman 1.x system assets
(`makehuman/data/` at commit `a8bc2d54ff0ac92e78ff71431b1023eda42bf482` of
https://github.com/makehumancommunity/makehuman): the hm08 base mesh, morph
targets, the default skeleton with its skin weights, and the high-poly eye proxy
and texture.

These assets were explicitly released under **CC0 1.0 Universal** (public domain
dedication) by their copyright holders (Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius, Jonas
Hauquier; original targets by Manuel Bastioni) in September 2020 — see the header
of every file and https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/.

Regenerate with `python tools/fetch_makehuman.py`.
